data.name: Renuka
data.gender_notes: Renuka is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Born of dust; the goddess Renuka
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit reṇu, 'dust, pollen' — 'born of dust'. Its root is Sanskrit reṇu (रेणु). Renuka, mother of Parashurama. Renuka is a Sanskrit name meaning “Born of dust; the goddess Renuka”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Renuka expresses “Born of dust; the goddess Renuka”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit reṇu, 'dust, pollen' — 'born of dust'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Renuka total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
